notes: Almost the whole sheet is the Mill Creek valley rail yard (B&O S.W. / C.H.&D. tracks) with Mill Creek near the west edge; the only street grid is Garrard Avenue (west building line x ~4915, east block corners x ~5280-5295) with the C.&L. R.R. track along it, and W. Liberty Street crossing the bottom on a viaduct over the tracks and the creek. Findlay, Poplar and Sherman come in from the east (sheet 202) and end at Garrard; west of Garrard is the rail yard. Two dashed lines continue Poplar's building lines (y ~3830 and ~4115) west across the yard to Mill Creek: an unopened/paper extension of Poplar, not recorded as a street. Circled figures (61', 60', 58') are grade elevations, not widths. The dash-dot line A-B at y ~520 is the match line to sheet 211.
